Web search built for AI: search results, page contents, similar links and cited answers.

## API key

1. Open [dashboard.exa.ai](https://dashboard.exa.ai/api-keys) and create an API key with only the access your apps need.
2. Copy it. It may be shown only once.

**What to create:** An API key from the Exa dashboard (the free tier gives $10 of credit a month).

Add it to your Gateway. It asks for the key:

```bash
everyapp provider add exa
```

### Use it in an app

In the app's `everyapp.config.ts`:

```ts
capabilities: {
  exa: { access: "read", why: "What the app does with it." },
},
```

The app calls Exa's [API](https://exa.ai/docs/reference/search) with `integrationFetch()`, and the Gateway adds the key. More in [API providers](/docs/agent/providers).

**Check it worked:** `everyapp provider show exa` shows the key as set.

**Cost:** Search $7 per 1k (auto and fast; lite $4), contents $1 per 1k pages, answer $5 per 1k; up to 10 results included.

**Rate limits:** 10 calls a second. Per team: /search and /answer 10 QPS, deep search 5, /contents 100.

Something wrong or missing? [Open an issue](https://github.com/every-app/every-app/issues/new?template=provider-request.yml&title=Provider%20guide%3A%20Exa).
